# Project Overview

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Purpose

My Tracks App is a single-module Android app that records a user's GPS position at a
configurable interval during a tracking session and turns the collected points into
distance/speed/stopped-vs-moving statistics and GPX/CSV exports (`app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/domain/session/SessionControllerImpl.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/domain/export/ExportService.kt`).

### Consumers and integrations

| System | Role |
|---|---|
| `MainActivity` (launcher Activity) | Composition root; only human-facing entrypoint (`app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/MainActivity.kt`) |
| `LocationForegroundService` | Background collection worker, independent of the Activity lifecycle (`app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/service/LocationForegroundService.kt`) |
| Google Play Services — `FusedLocationProviderClient` | Supplies raw GPS fixes (`com.google.android.gms:play-services-location:21.3.0`) |
| Google Maps SDK for Android | Renders the recorded route on the session-detail/tracking screens (`com.google.android.gms:play-services-maps:19.0.0`, API key wired via `AndroidManifest.xml` meta-data) |
| `android.location.Geocoder` | One-shot reverse geocoding of a session's first point (`app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/service/AndroidReverseGeocoder.kt`) |
| Local filesystem (`context.filesDir/exports`) | Destination for GPX/CSV export files (`AppNavigation.kt`'s `SessionDetailRoute.onExport`) |

### Macro flow

1. User opens **Nova sessão**, picks a sampling interval (`SamplingInterval`, 1–180s) and taps start; `NewSessionViewModel` calls `SessionController.startSession`.
2. `SessionControllerImpl.startSession` rejects the request (`SessionStartOutcome.PermissionDenied`) unless background location is granted; otherwise it persists a `TrackingSessionEntity` (status `ACTIVE`) before starting anything else.
3. `LocationForegroundServiceController.start` launches `LocationForegroundService`, which builds a `LocationRequest` from the user's `GpsPrecision` setting and starts `LocationCollector`.
4. `LocationCollector` accepts fixes only while the session is active, writes each as a `GpsPointEntity` (with observed sampling-interval drift), and fires `onFirstPointRecorded` once per session.
5. `FirstPointGeocodingCoordinator` fires a fire-and-forget reverse-geocode of the first point and, on success, calls `TrackingSessionDao.updateLocationName`.
6. Room's `Flow<List<GpsPointEntity>>` drives `TrackingViewModel`, which recomputes live stats via `StatsEngine` on every emission.
7. User taps "Finalizar"; `SessionControllerImpl.stopSession` stops the service, reads the final point set, runs `SegmentClassifier.classify` + `StatsEngine`, and persists the session as `FINISHED` with `stoppedTimeMillis`/`movingTimeMillis`/`averageSpeedMetersPerSecond`/`distanceMeters`.
8. From History/Session Detail, the user may export a `FINISHED` session; `ExportService.export` produces a GPX or CSV string (`GpxExporter`/`CsvExporter`), written to `filesDir/exports/session-<id>.<ext>`.

### Out of scope

- Cloud sync/backend upload — no HTTP client or remote API exists anywhere in the codebase (`api_surface.present: false` per repository inspection; no networking library beyond Play Services in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`).
- API 30+ two-step background-location permission flow — `AppNavigation.kt`'s `NewSessionRoute` comment explicitly documents this as "out of scope for this prototype", requesting only foreground location on API 30+.
- Room schema migrations — `AppDatabase.kt` uses `fallbackToDestructiveMigration()` with no `Migration` classes; a version bump wipes local data instead of migrating it.
